name: Pseudo Planche Push-Up
instructions: Begin in a push-up position with hands placed next to your hips or lower ribs, not under your shoulders.
Your fingers should point toward your feet or slightly outward.
Lean your body forward so your shoulders move well in front of your hands.
Keep your body in a straight line, engaging your core intensely.
Lower your body down while maintaining the forward lean.
Your elbows should stay tucked close to your sides.
Press back up to the starting position.
This variation mimics the planche position and builds tremendous shoulder and core strength.
Begin with hands positioned under shoulders and gradually move them lower as you progress.
